name: saica-supervise
description: Pure-skill plugin distilled from the SAICA-KG corpus: per-failure-mode heuristics for AI coding agents plus three pre-baked supervision-stack tiers (minimum / optimal / full-MECE). Drop-in markdown — zero runtime deps. The full MCP server (saica_lookup, saica_recommend, audit) lives in the parent saicakg repo for power users who want the live API.
